# Tier classifications for listed-repo health checks.
#
# Format: <tier> <owner/repo>   (one entry per line, case-insensitive)
# Tiers:
#   recommended  — default for all repos; checked and flagged normally.
#   historical   — upstream / predecessor repos credited for provenance; informational only.
#   archaeology  — repos explicitly called out as abandoned in the docs; informational only.
#
# Only `recommended` repos can trigger flags in the health report.
# historical and archaeology repos appear under their own collapsed headings.
#
# You generally do NOT need to add repos here:
#   • repos under a "Not Recommended", "⛔", or "for archaeology only" heading are
#     auto-classified as archaeology by the script's heuristic.
#   • Add explicit entries when a repo's surrounding text does not trigger the
#     heuristic but should still be exempt from flagging.

# --- historical ---
# Upstream repo this guide forks from; credited on every run but not evaluated.
historical meichthys/opensource_church_software
historical meichthys/christian_foss

# --- archaeology ---
# Explicitly-abandoned projects documented for historical context only.
archaeology aerogear/OpenVolunteerPlatform
archaeology Attendize/Attendize
archaeology Mailtrain-org/mailtrain
archaeology PodcastGenerator/PodcastGenerator
archaeology prabhu-qea/Vacation-Bible-School-System
